description: Single source of truth for quay release artifacts. release.yml must produce exactly this set — no more, no less.

sea-binaries.note: quay-native SEA binary is bundled inside the quay SEA archive (assembled together in the sea-release job). One archive per platform carries both binaries. The release.yml check validates the build steps exist, not archive separation.

plugin.note: Distributed via marketplace JSON files (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json + plugin/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) checked into the repo and version-bumped with each release. Included in the npm-pack tarball. Not a separate GitHub Release asset.

excludedPackages.reason: Reference Provider implementation proving the Provider ABI transfers to GitHub Issues as a real backend. Intentionally not published — no dist/ build, no npm tarball, no SEA binary. Run from source only. See README 'The four packages'.

Reference, read-only Provider implementation proving the Provider ABI transfers to a third, heterogeneous real backend (Backlog.md boards, DIR-039-B). Intentionally not published — no dist/ build, no npm tarball, no SEA binary. Run from source only. See README 'The four packages'.
